notes.title: Join our Discord
notes.content:
ERS has to be always ready to help but are you ready to meet other roadside assistance? Join our discord and check this out. 

Here you will find more information about updates and have a real chance to take part in creating our game by giving us feedback. 

JOIN OUR DISCORD
